title: Life-Score Forecast and Trend Alert
dataSources: Daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`), personal SLO status (`personalslo:status`), cross-signal correlations (`correlation:pair`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The meta layer — correlating every `index=personal` feed (sleep, activity, mood, weather, spend, productivity, home telemetry) into daily life scores, personal SLOs, and cross-signal anomaly detection, all computed in Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifescore:daily
| timechart span=1d avg(score) as score
| trendline sma7(score) as trend
| eval declining=if(score<trend AND trend<50,1,0)
description: Smooths your life score into a trend and warns when it is drifting downward over a sustained stretch.
value: A gentle downward-trend alert catches a slow slump early, when small corrections still turn things around.
implementation: Compute a moving average of your life score in `index=personal`; alert on a sustained decline.
visualization: Line chart of life score with a smoothed trend and alert band.
grandmaExplanation: It smooths your daily life score into a trend and warns if things are gradually sliding, so you can course-correct.
